sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Narendra Gupta,Mohammad Salim Khan
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. The applicant is the husband of the deceased.
The allegations were levelled that on account of non-payment of dowry, the daughter of the informant was killed.
The applicant is in custody since 12.09.2022.
3. The Counsel for the applicant has produced a copy of the deposition of the informant, who stated that he had got the FIR written only on account of mislead by the villagers.
4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.
Ravi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home, Lko.

sentences.text: In view of the said statement coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is in custody since 12.09.2022 and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
6. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Ravi be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.536 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 306, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of DP Act, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Sitapur on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;

( b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
